title: Google gives Gemini the ability to use your Mac for you
lede: Google's Gemini app for macOS can now operate the Mac itself, working through native apps, local files and websites in the background while the user keeps their own screen and cursor.

points: After a request, the agent's work plays in a live preview inside the chat while the user carries on with other things.
Users can pause, stop or approve each action before it happens.
Google pitches it for tedious work: filling forms, repeating a task across a batch of files, sorting files into folders and building slideshows.
It launches in English in the US and requires the Mac app plus a Google AI Plus, Pro or Ultra subscription.
It follows this week's wider rollout of Gemini Tasks, which signs into sites, makes purchases and books appointments.

sections.text: With Google joining OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta, desktop computer use is now standard in assistant apps, so Mac software is increasingly driven by agents as well as people.
